headline: 14 contracts catalogued on Ethereum; core addresses sourced from GitHub README, pufETH repo, Etherscan name tags, and Sherlock bug bounty scope page.

findings.text: D1: Etherscan name-tag search surfaced 3 labelled Puffer Finance addresses: pufETH Token (0xD9A442856C234a39a81a089C06451EBAa4306a72), Puffer Finance: Puffer Protocol proxy (0xf7b6b32492c2e13799d921e84202450131bd238b), and Puffer Finance: Operations Multisig (0xC0896ab1A8cae8c2C1d27d011eb955Cca955580d). PUFFER governance token also surfaced at 0x4d1c297d39c5c1277964d0e3f8aa901493664530.

D2: Official deployed-contracts doc at https://docs.puffer.fi/deployments/deployed-contracts/ defers to the Deployments-and-ACL GitHub repo for definitive addresses; direct fetch of that repo was blocked by allowlist. Set deployed_contracts_doc accordingly.

D3: No audit_links were pinned. GitHub README for puffer-contracts lists audits from Cantina/Spearbit, BlockSec (8 reports), SlowMist (6 reports), Nethermind, Creed, Quantstamp, Trail of Bits, and Immunefi Boost. PDF URLs recorded in protocol_metadata.audits (sample set). BlockSec audit confirmed PufferVault, PufferDepositor, Timelock as core scoped contracts.

D4: GitHub repo PufferFinance/puffer-contracts README (master branch, no pinned SHA available) lists PufferVault at 0xD9A442856C234a39a81a089C06451EBAa4306a72 and defers to Deployments-and-ACL for full list. Repo PufferFinance/pufETH README surfaced PufferDepositor (0x4aA799C5dfc01ee7d790e3bf1a7C2257CE1DcefF), AccessManager (0x8c1686069474410E6243425f4a10177a94EBEE11), Timelock (0x3C28B7c7Ba1A1f55c9Ce66b263B33B204f2126eA). Deployments-and-ACL repo fetch was blocked; SHA cannot be pinned this run.

D5: Protocol is Ethereum-only per pinned context; no multi-chain enumeration required. Bridged pufETH/PUFFER representations exist on other chains per Sherlock scope but core protocol logic is Ethereum mainnet only.

D6: PufferProtocol is a factory-like registry for PufferModule instances. Full module enumeration was not possible this run due to fetch quota exhaustion; factory address 0xf7b6b32492c2e13799d921e84202450131bd238b recorded with cap notice in unknowns.

D7: Role taxonomy applied — token (pufETH/PUFFER/ValidatorTicket), vault (PufferVault), router (PufferDepositor/PufferDepositorV2), admin (AccessManager), timelock (Timelock), multisig (Operations/Community/Pause multisigs), oracle (PufferOracleV2), factory (PufferProtocol/PufferModuleManager), other (PufferRevenueDepositor, L1RewardManager, GuardianModule, EnclaveVerifier).

D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to at least one fetched or search-returned URL. PufferProtocol implementation 0xd05edf0bc5c2c960a7eb5485c8f965c151df2b00 appears only in Etherscan search snippet — recorded in admin_addresses with evidence from that snippet. Sherlock ACL table snippet referenced for full contract list but partial page render means some sub-addresses (Community Multisig, Pause Guardian) could not be confirmed with specific 0x addresses — placed in unknowns.

rationale.verdict: Walked puffer.fi website, GitHub PufferFinance/puffer-contracts README, GitHub PufferFinance/pufETH README, Etherscan name-tag search results, Sherlock bug bounty scope snippet, and BlockSec audit summary. Catalogued 14 contracts; Deployments-and-ACL repo (authoritative source) was blocked, preventing full address enumeration — future runs should target that repo directly.

protocol_metadata.about: Puffer Finance is a decentralized native liquid restaking protocol (nLRP) built on EigenLayer that allows users to deposit ETH and receive pufETH, a reward-bearing ERC-4626 token representing their restaked position. Stakers earn Ethereum PoS rewards, EigenLayer AVS restaking rewards, and validator ticket revenue, with the pufETH conversion rate increasing over time as rewards accrue. The protocol enables permissionless validator operation with anti-slashing technology (Secure-Signer), and the PufferVault holds protocol assets (ETH, wETH, stETH) while delegating them to EigenLayer restaking operators. Access control is governed by an OpenZeppelin AccessManager, a Timelock with a 7-day minimum delay, and a set of multisig wallets, with governance progressively transitioning toward a PUFFER token-weighted DAO.
